messages:
sara: Hey team — FinTechCo wants a 2-week POC where all customer data must stay in DE (no egress outside Germany). Can hosted API satisfy this or do we need Dedicated/Private? Also need sub-processor list and an estimate for delta in monthly cost.

diego: Short answer: hosted can if we pin requests to eu-central-1 and avoid features that hit external analytics. But there are caveats re: shared infra and some subprocessors. :thinking_face:

maria: +1 — legal needs to confirm subprocessor visibility for the specific account. We can provide the CSV inventory and SOC audits but for absolute data sovereignty we recommend Dedicated or Private.

sara: Customer asked specifically: (1) Is there any metadata that could leave region (billing, metrics)? (2) If we route to eu-central-1, are model fallbacks ever routed out-of-region?

diego: (1) Billing writes live to centralized billing service in AWS eu-central by default; however billing dashboards may be aggregated in US for analytics unless you opt out. We can opt out for enterprise customers. (2) Model fallbacks — by default our smart routing prefers same-region compatible model variants. Fallback to another region only happens if capacity is exhausted AND customer allows cross-region failover in their routing policy.

samir: For the POC we can set routing_policy to strict regional_pin so no cross-region failover. That will lower availability if capacity spikes, but meets their residency constraint. I can spin up a Dedicated pool for the POC if they want SLA for throughput.

sara: Cost ask — can you ballpark Dedicated delta for a small 2x A10G pool vs hosted routing? They expect low-volume (~50 reqs/min, short contexts).

diego: Ballpark: hosted with regional_pin: same per-token rates + ~10% egress premium. Dedicated reservation (small pool) roughly $12k/mo committed; on-demand burst + per-token compute still applies. For 50 reqs/min it might be cheaper hosted with opt-outs, but Dedicated gives isolation and predictable throughput.

maria: I'll attach the subprocessor CSV and the legal checklist. For hosted we disclose: AWS (eu-central), Datadog (EU-only logs by config), PagerDuty, Sentry (EU retention available on request), Stripe (billing). If they require no third-party processors at all, only Private on-prem will meet that.

sara: Great — do we have a short config snippet I can share that enforces regional pinning?

diego: Yep, share this minimal snippet (can paste in the POC runbook):

```json
{
  "routing_policy": "regional_pin",
  "preferred_region": "eu-central-1",
  "allow_cross_region_failover": false
}
```

alex: FYI I talked to infra — for the POC we can enable:
- prefix KV cache pinned to eu-central
- no telemetry export to non-EU by default
- KMS keys in eu-central (customer-managed if they want)

ops-bot: deploy-job #poc-eu started by samir — provisioning 2x small instances in eu-central-1. ETA ~ 14m. :rocket:

samir: I'll own the Dedicated pool setup if they sign. For now I'll configure hosted with the regional_pin snippet and disable analytics exports.

sara: Next actions: (1) maria to DM subprocessor CSV + SOC links to FinTechCo legal; (2) diego to add the snippet to the runbook and confirm telemetry opt-out steps; (3) samir to confirm Dedicated pricing and give a written delta estimate. I'll sync with customer after those items.

maria: On it — sending CSV and the standard EU DPA attachments now. :email:

diego: I'll PR the runbook updates and drop a link here when done.

samir: Pricing note: I'll lock in a formal quote before EOD.

sara: Thanks all :heart: — ping me here once quote + CSV + runbook link are ready.
